subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is the mark of the triumph of Rama, an avatar of Vishnu, over the 10-headed demon king Ravana?
solution: The correct answer is **Dussehra.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__** • The **tenth day **after Sharad Navratri is celebrated as **Dussehra or Vijayadashami.** • Dussehra** is the festival that marks the triumph of Lord Rama over the demon king Ravana.** • It is a major Hindu festival that is celebrated in the month of Ashwin. • Dussehra **is a celebration of good over evil** • **Dussehra** is one of the major** Hindu festivals** that marks the **end of Navratri.** • The festival is celebrated as the **victory** of **Lord Rama over Ravana**
